name: Nanbu Haruka
source:
By happenstance, she shares the same hobby with the protagonist and they hit it off.

Fluffy and unique step sister, who the protagonist feels a kinship with. Iori's older sister. Has a terrible tolerance for alcohol.

[Adapted from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HP/ichaane/character333.html]official website[/url]]
